concept: KMS: automatic key rotation for a customer managed key
tests: Centralized key management with annual rotation and no application changes.
expected: KMS customer managed key with automatic rotation enabled: yearly, same key ID, old data still decrypts. Triggers: "rotate annually", "no application changes", "LEAST operational overhead".
why_not: Manual rotation and re-encryption are heavy overhead; SSE-S3 gives no control/audit of rotation policy; storing keys in S3 is an anti-pattern.
